title: Short, informal poll in #random about favourite internal model names (Blueberry, Echo, Atlas, Sparrow) with quick tally and light banter about stickers and a follow-up lunch vote.
text:
Short, informal poll in #random about favourite internal model names (Blueberry, Echo, Atlas, Sparrow) with quick tally and light banter about stickers and a follow-up lunch vote.

mia: quick micro-poll — favourite internal model name? reply with the option number or emoji. options: 1) Redwood-Blueberry 🫐 2) Redwood-Echo 🔊 3) Redwood-Atlas 🗺️ 4) Redwood-Sparrow 🐦 i'll close in 12 minutes — go!
jon: 3
sam: 2
leila: 1 (blueberry sticker please)
anya: 3 +1 for atlas
oliver: 4 for the bird vibes 🐦
sam: also can we get stickers of the winner? :eyes:
mia: cool, thanks — tallying now
deploy-bot: pollbot: counting votes...
mia: results: Redwood-Atlas — 2 (jon, anya) ; Redwood-Echo — 1 (sam) ; Redwood-Blueberry — 1 (leila) ; Redwood-Sparrow — 1 (oliver). Winner: Redwood-Atlas 🎉
leila: Atlas is a solid name, love it
oliver: stickers when? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
mia: i'll follow up with design. also, optional lunchtime vote: tacos or ramen? quick thumbs on this thread if you're eating with us later :thumbsup: tacos, :ramen: ramen
